import json
import os
import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Suppress tqdm progress bars
for module in ["tqdm"]:
    try:
        mod = __import__(module)
        if hasattr(mod, "tqdm"):
            mod.tqdm = lambda *args, **kwargs: None
    except ImportError:
        pass


def load_json_data(filepath):
    """Load JSON file and return as DataFrame"""
    with open(filepath, "r") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    return pd.DataFrame(data)


def preprocess(df, keep_target=True):
    """Clean and preprocess data for LightGBM - consistent across all data sources"""
    # Remove non-informative columns
    remove_cols = ["request_id"]

    # Special handling for boolean fields
    for col in ["post_was_edited"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            try:
                df[col] = df[col].astype(bool)
            except:
                pass

    # Drop array-type columns that don't work with LightGBM
    array_cols = ["requester_subreddits_at_request"]
    for col in array_cols:
        if col in df.columns:
            df = df.drop(columns=[col])

    # Keep only useful columns based on description.md
    allowed_text_cols = ["request_text", "request_text_edit_aware", "request_title"]

    # Numerical columns from description.md
    allowed_num_cols = [
        "number_of_downvotes_of_request_at_retrieval",
        "number_of_upvotes_of_request_at_retrieval",
        "request_number_of_comments_at_retrieval",
        "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
        "requester_account_age_in_days_at_retrieval",
        "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
        "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_retrieval",
        "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_comments_at_retrieval",
        "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_retrieval",
        "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_posts_at_retrieval",
        "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_retrieval",
        "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
        "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
        "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_retrieval",
        "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
        "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_retrieval",
        "unix_timestamp_of_request",
        "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
    ]

    # Get target column
    target_col = "requester_received_pizza" if keep_target else None

    # Select allowed columns
    final_cols = []
    for col in df.columns:
        if col in remove_cols:
            continue
        if col == target_col:
            final_cols.append(col)
        elif col in allowed_text_cols:
            final_cols.append(col)
        elif col in allowed_num_cols:
            final_cols.append(col)

    df_used = df[final_cols].copy()
    df_used = df_used.reset_index(drop=True)

    # Convert target to numeric (0/1) if kept
    if keep_target and target_col in df_used.columns:
        try:
            df_used[target_col] = pd.to_numeric(df_used[target_col], errors="coerce")
            df_used[target_col] = df_used[target_col].fillna(0).astype(int)
        except:
            df_used[target_col] = df_used[target_col].astype(float)

    # Fill missing values for numeric columns
    for col in df_used.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns:
        if col != target_col:
            df_used[col] = df_used[col].fillna(df_used[col].median())

    return df_used.drop(columns=target_col) if not keep_target else df_used


def main():
    # Load data
    print("Loading training data...")
    train_df = load_json_data("input/train.json")
    print(f"Training samples: {len(train_df)}")

    print("Loading test data...")
    test_df = load_json_data("input/test.json")
    print(f"Test samples: {len(test_df)}")

    # Extract IDs early for later use
    train_ids = train_df["request_id"].values.copy()
    test_ids = test_df["request_id"].values.copy()

    # Preprocess both datasets with same function for consistency
    X_train_full = preprocess(train_df, keep_target=True)
    y_train = X_train_full["requester_received_pizza"]
    y_train = y_train.values

    X_train = preprocess(train_df, keep_target=False)
    X_test = preprocess(test_df, keep_target=False)
    X_train = X_train.values
    X_test = X_test.values

    # IMPORTANT: Train/validation split BEFORE any training
    # Use stratified split to maintain class distribution
    X_train_split, X_val, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
        X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
    )

    # Build datasets for LightGBM
    train_dataset = lgb.Dataset(X_train_split, label=y_train_split)
    val_dataset = lgb.Dataset(X_val, reference=train_dataset, label=y_val_split)

    # Define hyperparameters for better performance
    params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_logloss",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "min_child_samples": 15,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
        "max_depth": 8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "reg_alpha": 0.1,
        "reg_lambda": 0.1,
        "verbose": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "force_col_wise": False,
        "feature_fraction": 0.9,
        "scale_pos_weight": 1.0,
    }

    print("Training LightGBM model...")
    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_dataset,
        num_boost_round=1500,
        valid_sets=[val_dataset],
        callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(period=10)],
        verbose_eval=-1,
    )

    # Validate on held-out set (NOT refitting on this set!)
    val_preds = model.predict(val_dataset.data.X, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
    val_auc = roc_auc_score(val_dataset.data.label, val_preds)
    print(f"\nValidation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

    # Predict on test set
    test_preds = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
    print(f"\n=== FINAL RESULTS ===")
    print(f"Number of test predictions: {len(test_preds)}")
    print(f"Mean prediction probability: {np.mean(test_preds):.4f}")
    print(f"Max prediction probability: {np.max(test_preds):.4f}")
    print(f"Min prediction probability: {np.min(test_preds):.4f}")

    # Create submission file (CRITICAL: MUST SAVE TO submission/submission.csv)
    os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

    sub_df = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "request_id": list(test_ids),
            "requester_received_pizza": [round(float(p), 6) for p in test_preds],
        }
    )

    sub_df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("\n✓ Submission file saved to submission/submission.csv")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    return val_auc


if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = main()
    print(f"\nEvaluation Metric Score: {result:.6f}")
